reporter_name.description: The full name of the technician who recorded the message.
reporter_name.title: Reporter Name

asset_identifier.description: The identifier of the specific asset or piece of equipment that is faulty.
asset_identifier.title: Asset Identifier

location.description: The location of the fault within the facility.
location.title: Location

fault_description.description: A description of what is broken, malfunctioning, or requires attention.
fault_description.title: Fault Description

urgency.description: The urgency level of the fault.
urgency.title: Urgency

observation_date.description: The date the fault was observed, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
observation_date.title: Observation Date

observation_time.description: The time the fault was observed, in HH:MM (24-hour) format.
observation_time.title: Observation Time

actions_taken.description: A list of immediate actions the technician already took before or while reporting.
actions_taken.title: Actions Taken

uncertain_fields.description: A list of field names whose values could not be reliably extracted.
uncertain_fields.title: Uncertain Fields
